GameConditionDef.label: the Burn
GameConditionDef.description: The Contagion's storm has torn open. Raw UV is scorching everything under open sky: natives are diving for roof, canopy and water; anyone else out in it takes a sunscald dose. The fog is gone — ranged weapons work.
GameConditionDef.startMessage: The storm tears open — the Burn. Get under a roof, a tree, or into water.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The cloud closes over the valley again. The Burn is over.
